description: Who read a doc and how. Returns the share link, total and unique views, average reading time, when it was last opened, and the ten most recent viewers with their time, pages and whether they read to the end. Use it for 'who saw it', 'how is it doing', 'what is the link', and as the material for a follow-up email that refers to what each person actually read. Owner only; viewer data stays with the doc's owner. Identify the doc via doc_name (fuzzy-matched) or slug.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

doc_name.description: Name of the doc (fuzzy-matched). Pass this or slug.

slug.description: The doc's slug or share URL.

name: get_doc_status
title: View doc stats
